description: Ship several runnable example topologies with THIN AI app/service examples — barely more than local-inference wrappers — so a user sees Agora Studio populated (graph + connections + messages + specs) without wiring their own setup first. The thin examples live under `examples/` beside `participant-starter/` (the ~20-line copy-and-run participant that serves an AgentCard carrying a KCB manifest and answers one A2A `message/send`), consume the PUBLISHED `@agora/sdk` only, and are NEVER imported by the SDK (dependency points one way — the SDK stays the single publishable surface). The example config is loaded by Studio's runtime config path (60) as a user config would be — these are sample data, not a bundled roster (capability, never caller). Scope: `examples/` (new thin participants + example topology configs) + a Studio-side loader for the example config; consumes `@agora/sdk`. agora gates on `make check`.

userStories.title: Thin local-inference example participants over the published SDK
userStories.description: Add thin example participants under examples/ (local-inference wrappers) modeled on participant-starter, each serving an AgentCard/KCB manifest over the wire and consuming @agora/sdk only.
acceptanceCriteria: New thin example participants live under `examples/` (alongside `participant-starter/`), each barely more than a local-inference wrapper that serves an AgentCard carrying a KCB manifest and answers over MCP/A2A, depending on the PUBLISHED `@agora/sdk` (and `@agora/schemas`) only — no other in-repo package

The SDK is never imported by these examples in reverse: `clients/sdk/`'s `index.test.ts` SDK_API drift test still passes (examples consume the SDK, the SDK does not consume them), and the examples stay runnable the way `participant-starter/` is (Node strip-only loader compatible — no TS parameter properties/enums)

userStories.title: Example topologies that populate Studio out of the box
userStories.description: Provide several example topology configs wiring the thin participants together, loadable by Studio's runtime config path so a fresh user sees a populated graph/connections/messages/specs.
acceptanceCriteria: Several example topology configs are provided as sample data (marked as such — sample, not a default roster) and are loaded through Studio's runtime config path (from 60), so loading one populates the graph (61), connections (62), messages (63), analytics (64), and spec viewer (65)

A test asserts loading an example config yields the expected nodes/edges in Studio, and that the examples are sample data only — Studio still starts empty with no config (the 60 backbone ships with no preconfigured participants)
`make check` green; Studio stays source-first, observer-only, and free of any hard-wired participant literal (project names in examples are marked sample data per CLAUDE.md)
